meta.title: Resend alternative: sending flows and pricing
meta.description: Compare compatible sending flows in MepMail, with API, SMTP and MCP. Historical competitor pricing reference, with its date and feature differences.

title: Coming from Resend? <highlight>Keep the SDK.</highlight>
lead: For sending flows compatible with the Resend SDK, change the base URL and key. See the migration guide, available features and the historical price reference below.
note: Free to start: 100 emails a day, no card. We help you migrate and set up your sending domain.

claim.title: How to read this comparison
claim.body: Percentages are arithmetic differences against the dated reference, not a promise of current savings. MepMail’s US$20 introduction and annual offer are excluded; also compare features, limits and support.

same.title: What carries over
items: The official Resend SDK: new Resend("ms_…", { baseUrl: "https://api.mepmail.dev" }).
The sending endpoints you already call: /emails, /emails/batch and /emails/{id}/cancel.
Domain, key, webhook, template and suppression management, with the same request shapes where the two overlap.
The SMTP relay, for stacks that send over SMTP instead of HTTPS.

different.title: What does not carry over
items: Inbound email, dedicated IPs and SSO are not part of the compatibility promise.
The management surface is smaller: we cover sending, domains, keys, webhooks, templates, suppressions and contacts, but not every endpoint Resend ships.
Free and Starter stop at a daily cap instead of billing overage.
Attachment limit per message: 1 MB on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro, 10 MB on Scale.

steps.title: Three steps to get started.
items: Create the account and add your sending domain: we generate the DKIM and MAIL FROM records and wait for verification with you.
Swap the base URL and the key in your Resend client. The SDK and your send calls stay exactly as they are.
Send a test and follow the log in the panel. Then move production traffic.
steps.note: Domain propagation and verification can take longer than the migration itself; automatic verification runs every 15 minutes. Using flows outside the compatible set? Tell us before migrating: we review them with you and say plainly what is not equivalent.

close.title: Migrate and cut the bill.
close.body: Create the free account, keep the SDK you already have and send the first test today.
